details.description: Sensitive tokens/keys are hardcoded, risking credential leakage.
details.fix_explanation: Load secrets from environment variables with safe defaults for development and require overrides in production.
details.secure_code_snippet:
PAYMENT_TOKEN = get_secret("PAYMENT_TOKEN", default="dev-payment-token")
MAIL_SERVER_KEY = get_secret("MAIL_SERVER_KEY", default="")
INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET = get_secret("INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET", default="dev-internal-secret")

details.description: MD5 is insecure for authentication/authorization tokens.
details.fix_explanation: Use HMAC with SHA-256 over the username using a secret key.

details.description: User-controlled input is concatenated into SQL query strings.
details.fix_explanation: Validate `id` as integer and use parameterized queries.
details.secure_code_snippet:
uid_int = int(uid)
cur.execute("SELECT id, name, balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (uid_int,))

details.description: Arbitrary URLs from user input are fetched without validation.
details.fix_explanation: Validate notify URLs against allowed hosts and permitted schemes before issuing requests.

details.description: User-supplied file paths are opened directly, allowing traversal outside intended directory.
details.fix_explanation: Resolve paths and enforce they remain within a whitelisted config directory; reject traversal.
details.secure_code_snippet:
resolved = (CONFIG_DIR / candidate).resolve() if not candidate.is_absolute() else candidate.resolve()
if CONFIG_DIR not in resolved.parents and resolved != CONFIG_DIR: raise ValueError(...)

details.description: Unvalidated input is interpolated into a shell command with shell=True.
details.fix_explanation: Sanitize export name and use Python's zipfile module instead of shelling out.

details.description: Flask debug mode is enabled, exposing sensitive traceback information and a remote code execution console.
details.fix_explanation: Disable debug by default; control via environment variables for local development only.
